message.content:
Here’s a quick recipe you can copy‑paste into your terminal or script to pull just the record IDs for the **CNAME** entries of `sample.com`:

```bash
curl -s \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123" \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records?record_type=CNAME \
| jq -r '.data[].id'
```

Or, if you prefer Python:

```python
import requests, json

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records"
params = {"record_type": "CNAME"}
headers = {"x-apikey": "secret123"}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
resp.raise_for_status()
ids = [item["id"] for item in resp.json()["data"]]
print("\n".join(ids))
```

Both snippets hit the `/domains/{domain}/records` endpoint with the `record_type=CNAME` filter, then stream out only the `"id"` fields from each record object. Replace `sample.com` and `secret123` with your actual domain and API key.
